scope: One static full-page codex visual concept; no game integration
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE finished high-fidelity PORTRAIT 9:16 mobile-game COLLECTION PAGE redesign, intended 1080×1920, full-bleed opaque artwork with no phone frame. Game: 泡泡小队, same cute rounded original bubble-creature cast and candy-jelly illustration style as the references.
REFERENCE ROLES: image 1 is the CURRENT codex page, for its functions and 5-column 4-row collection structure only: redesign it, do not copy its dark overlay or crowded background. Image 2 is the EXACT main character 小蓝: preserve this blue round character's face, two cheek fins, small top curl and body proportions. Image 3 is the EXACT 20-character cast in correct collection order; preserve their distinct identities, never invent new creatures. Image 4 is the current approved milk-white UI card material; use its clean light surface and thin soft blue edge instead of thick shiny blue frames.
DESIGN DIRECTION: a bright, calm 'cloud-top friends album'. Self-contained pale sky-blue to pearl-white background with very faint soft cloud wisps at the edges and just a few small translucent bubbles around the hero. NO home-page logo, NO underlying home characters or scenery showing through, NO dark modal overlay. Clean visual hierarchy, generous spacing, rounded bold Chinese type, deep navy #163E6D text, small restrained glossy highlights. Character colors remain vivid; the interface stays lighter and quieter.
LAYOUT measured on the intended 1080×1920 page:
- Top y=50..140: centered title '泡泡图鉴', large deep navy rounded text, tiny bubble accents only. Upper-right a small coral jelly circular close button with a crisp white ×. No title ribbon, currency, settings button or extra navigation.
- y=160..245: quiet slim collection summary: exact text '已收集 8 / 20' and a thin rounded ice-blue progress track filled 40% in sky blue. No percentage text, rewards or stars.
- Hero showcase y=285..700: large original 小蓝 centered, roughly 320 px visible height, cheerful open eyes and happy smile, standing on a small low pale-blue jelly pedestal. A very soft cyan circular halo behind him, only 3 small floating soap bubbles, no bright rays or large orbit rings. Hero must be the strongest focal point.
- y=735..940: centered name '小蓝' in large navy rounded text, beside it a small pale-blue personality pill reading '队长'. Under it, two readable lines: '泡泡小队的队长，挺胸一喊，' and '大家就出发！'. Small muted line below: '第 1 关加入队伍'. Do not add stats, upgrade buttons, rarity, weapons or abilities.
- y=995: section heading left '伙伴一览'; small helper right '点击卡片查看'.
- y=1050..1770: EXACTLY 20 complete cards in EXACTLY 5 columns by 4 rows, consistent spacing and generous side margins around 48px. Each card approximately 184×164 px with 16–18px gutters. Rounded milk-white cards, delicate sky-blue rim and tiny soft shadow, no thick glass border. FIRST 8 cards are obtained and show the exact colorful cast from reference 3, each with readable navy name beneath. Remaining 12 cards show distinct muted blue-gray character silhouettes, each with a SMALL subtle lock icon and its exact unlock-level label. The first 小蓝 card is selected: its OWN thin rim is warm gold, a very light cream face and tiny gold check in the upper-right; no extra surrounding frame or giant glow. Never make selected card obscure adjacent cards.
CARD CONTENT IN ROW ORDER: row 1 = 小蓝 (blue, selected), 小绿 (green), 小橙 (orange), 小紫 (purple long ears), 小白 (white). Row 2 = 小黄 (yellow antennae), 小黑 (black spiky), 小红 (red), LOCKED winged peach silhouette label '第5关', LOCKED pink pigtail silhouette label '第5关'. Row 3 = LOCKED brown round ears '第5关', LOCKED berry bun '第5关', LOCKED pale mint wisp '第6关', LOCKED cyan jellyfish '第7关', LOCKED lime star '第7关'. Row 4 = LOCKED mint flat dumpling '第8关', LOCKED lavender cloud '第10关', LOCKED slate blue horn '第11关', LOCKED forest two-stacked-bubbles '第12关', LOCKED violet gem '第19关'. There must be 8 colorful obtained cards and 12 locked silhouette cards, matching '8 / 20'.
- Bottom y=1830: quiet small helper text '通关新关卡，认识更多伙伴'. Keep safe bottom padding. No big bottom button or extra cards.
Polished production UI concept, clean light and airy appearance, thin material edges, coherent controlled candy highlights, clear Chinese typography, accurate character identities. No labels A/B, no explanatory annotations, no watermark. Show the entire single page including all 20 cards. Preserve the exact 5×4 order, readable text and open spacing.
exportOperation: Sharp resize to 1080×1920, phone-scale proof and labeled comparison only; no repainting.
